en.title: Tournament Quota Packages
en.excerpt: Detailed comparison of Free Starter, Standard Organizer, and Elite Organizer plans, including quotas and advanced features.
en.content:
Quota-Based Pricing Model

Archeris uses an event quota model rather than recurring monthly software retainers. Organizers purchase tournament capacity when needed, ensuring cost efficiency for both occasional club shoots and multi-day international championships.

Free Starter Plan

Every newly registered Organizer account automatically receives 1 Free Tournament Quota. This plan allows committees to explore the entire digital workflow:

  • Capacity: Up to 64 registered participants.
  • Core scoring: Mobile scorekeeper portal and live public leaderboard.
  • Target allocation: Basic lane assignment (1A, 1B).
  • Elimination: Standard individual Olympic round brackets.

Standard Organizer Plan

Tailored for regional opens, inter-school cups, and club championships:

  • Capacity: Up to 256 participants per tournament.
  • Automated workflows: Automated target lane allocator (1A-1D) and automated team synchronization.
  • Financial tools: Instant digital payments (QRIS and Virtual Accounts) and participant invoice tracking.
  • Output documents: Automated certificate generator with QR codes and Official Result Book PDF export.

Elite Organizer Plan

Designed for national championships, multi-day circuits, and federation-sanctioned opens:

  • Capacity: Unlimited participants and unlimited categories.
  • Advanced features: Multi-range distance configurations, team elimination brackets, and Big-Screen LED stadium display mode.
  • Branding: Custom sponsor banner overlays and dedicated technical setup assistance.

Detailed Plan Comparison

All plans include full cloud data backups, SSL encryption, offline score caching resilience, and zero on-site server installation requirements.
